title: The Defeat of Death
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The defeat of death means that death, the last enemy, will be destroyed through the victory of Jesus Christ. Believers grieve death honestly, but they do not grieve as those without hope.
summary: The defeat of death means that death, the last enemy, will be destroyed through the victory of Jesus Christ. Believers grieve death honestly, but they do not grieve as those without hope.
christFocus: Jesus Christ conquered death by His resurrection and will finally destroy death at His return. He is the resurrection and the life, and those who belong to Him will live with Him forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Death entered through sin and stands as an enemy over fallen humanity. Scripture does not call death natural or good; it names death as an enemy.

Christ has already broken the power of death through His resurrection. Death no longer has dominion over Him, and His victory guarantees the future resurrection of His people.

The final defeat of death will be seen when the dead are raised and God wipes away every tear. Death itself will be no more.

This doctrine gives believers courage in the face of mortality. Death is still painful, but it is a defeated enemy for those who belong to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Death brings grief, fear, separation, and questions that cannot be answered by shallow optimism. Believers need a hope stronger than denial.

The defeat of death comforts the grieving and strengthens the suffering. Christ does not merely comfort people through death; He will finally destroy death itself.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Grieve honestly, but grieve with resurrection hope. Bring fear of death to Christ, comfort others with His victory, and live faithfully knowing that the last enemy will not stand forever.
